Source: SELECT CONVERT(nvarchar(128),SERVERPROPERTY('ServerName')) AS Instance, CONVERT(nvarchar(128),SERVERPROPERTY('ComputerNamePhysicalNetBIOS')) AS ComputerName, CONVERT(nvarchar(128),SERVERPROPERTY('InstanceName')) AS InstanceName, CONVERT(nvarchar(128),SERVERPROPERTY('Edition')) AS Edition, CONVERT(varchar(30),SERVERPROPERTY('ProductVersion')) AS ProductVersion, CONVERT(int,SERVERPROPERTY('ProcessID')) AS SqlProcessId;
ClientConnections: SELECT s.session_id AS SessionId,c.client_net_address AS ClientAddress,c.local_net_address AS LocalAddress,s.host_name AS HostName,s.program_name AS ProgramName,s.client_interface_name AS ClientInterfaceName,s.original_login_name AS LoginName,DB_NAME(s.database_id) AS DatabaseName,c.net_transport AS NetTransport,c.auth_scheme AS AuthScheme,c.encrypt_option AS EncryptOption FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions s LEFT JOIN sys.dm_exec_connections c ON c.session_id=s.session_id AND c.parent_connection_id IS NULL WHERE s.is_user_process=1 AND s.session_id<>@@SPID;
Databases: SELECT database_id AS Id, name AS Name, state_desc AS State, compatibility_level AS CompatibilityLevel, create_date AS CreateDate, is_read_only AS IsReadOnly FROM sys.databases WHERE database_id > 4 AND source_database_id IS NULL;
LinkedServers: SELECT name AS Name, provider AS Provider, product AS Product, is_linked AS IsLinked FROM sys.servers WHERE is_linked = 1;
Credentials: SELECT name AS Name FROM sys.credentials;
Principals: SELECT name AS Name, type_desc AS Type FROM sys.server_principals WHERE type IN ('U','G');
Audits: SELECT name AS Name, is_state_enabled AS Enabled FROM sys.server_audits;
Providers: SELECT name AS Name, is_enabled AS Enabled FROM sys.cryptographic_providers;
Triggers: SELECT t.name AS Name, m.definition AS Text, t.is_disabled AS Disabled FROM sys.server_triggers t LEFT JOIN sys.server_sql_modules m ON m.object_id=t.object_id;
Mail: SELECT name AS Name FROM msdb.dbo.sysmail_profile;
Jobs: SELECT j.name AS Name,j.enabled AS Enabled,s.step_id AS StepId,s.subsystem AS Subsystem,s.command AS Command,s.database_name AS DatabaseName FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobs j LEFT JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobsteps s ON s.job_id=j.job_id;
Files: SELECT file_id AS Id,type_desc AS Type,name AS Name,physical_name AS PhysicalName,size/128.0 AS SizeMB,CONVERT(float,FILEPROPERTY(name,'SpaceUsed'))/128.0 AS UsedMB FROM sys.database_files;
Definitions: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(o.object_id) + '.' + o.name AS Object,m.definition AS Text,CONVERT(bit,CASE WHEN m.definition IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Encrypted FROM sys.objects o INNER JOIN sys.sql_modules m ON m.object_id=o.object_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0;
Assemblies: SELECT name AS Name,permission_set_desc AS PermissionSet FROM sys.assemblies WHERE is_user_defined=1;
FileStream: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(t.object_id)+'.'+t.name AS Name FROM sys.tables t WHERE t.is_filetable=1 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id=t.object_id AND c.is_filestream=1) UNION SELECT name FROM sys.filegroups WHERE type='FD';
Broker: SELECT s.name AS Name FROM sys.services s JOIN sys.service_queues q ON q.object_id=s.service_queue_id WHERE q.is_ms_shipped=0;
Dependencies: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(referencing_id)+'.'+OBJECT_NAME(referencing_id) AS Object,referenced_server_name AS ServerName,referenced_database_name AS DatabaseName,referenced_schema_name AS SchemaName,referenced_entity_name AS EntityName,is_ambiguous AS Ambiguous FROM sys.sql_expression_dependencies WHERE referenced_database_name IS NOT NULL OR referenced_server_name IS NOT NULL OR is_ambiguous=1;
Synonyms: SELECT SCHEMA_NAME(schema_id)+'.'+name AS Name,base_object_name AS BaseObject FROM sys.synonyms;
ObjectNames: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(object_id)+'.'+name AS Name FROM sys.objects WHERE name='NEXT' AND is_ms_shipped=0 UNION SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(object_id)+'.'+OBJECT_NAME(object_id)+'.'+name FROM sys.columns WHERE name='NEXT';
DatabasePrincipals: SELECT name AS Name,type_desc AS Type FROM sys.database_principals WHERE type IN ('U','G');
SkuFeatures: SELECT feature_name AS Name FROM sys.dm_db_persisted_sku_features;
ExternalDataSources: SELECT name AS Name,location AS Location,type_desc AS Type FROM sys.external_data_sources;
